criteria.criterion: `pct_of_cap` no longer clamps, so a value over the cap publishes its true ratio. Proven by a unit test driving the function with numerator > denominator and asserting the returned value is > 100, plus one at exactly the cap asserting 100.

The three call sites (docker storage, BuildKit cache, journal) publish unclamped values, and a test pins that each is derived through the unclamped path — so a future re-introduction of a clamp at any single site is caught.

The change is checked against every consumer of the three metrics before landing: the CloudWatch alarms in `monitoring_autodeploy.tf` and any dashboard or doc that assumes a 0-100 range. State explicitly whether any alarm threshold or unit needs adjusting, or why none does.

criteria.criterion: [non-codebase] The live BuildKit overshoot is re-measured after the fix and the published percentage is shown to match `docker system df` divided by `builder.gc.maxUsedSpace` — i.e. the metric reports the real ratio, not 100.
